commands.command: set -e; EXPECTED=c8652aa6eaaf23c07b809c44b0ae98b3c435c555; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; adb connect 192.168.0.100:34771 || true; echo '=== DEVICES ==='; adb devices -l; SERIAL=$(adb devices -l | awk '$2=="device" && /model:SM_S906B/ && $1 ~ /:/ {print $1; exit}'); if [ -z "$SERIAL" ]; then SERIAL=$(adb devices -l | awk '$2=="device" && /model:SM_S906B/ {print $1; exit}'); fi; test -n "$SERIAL"; echo serial=$SERIAL; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/dev/null; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; set +e; OUTPUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe construct" 2>&1); RC=$?; set -e; echo "$OUTPUT"; echo probe_exit=$RC; echo offcall_call_assistant_complete=true
